articles.title: Sing It, and Link Will Play It
articles.summary: In the Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time, players can hum, sing, or yell a tune into the microphone, and the game will play the matching song for Link.

articles.title: It's Great to Be a Cow in World of Warcraft: Forever
articles.summary: A forgotten tauren skill called Plainsrunning is back in WoW: Forever, and Blizzard made it so tauren at level 1 can run as fast as a level-40 mount.

articles.title: Jennie Sings About Sisterhood in a New Song for Netflix's Steps
articles.summary: Jennie's new song 'Someone to Hold' is about sister love. It is part of Steps, a Netflix cartoon movie about Cinderella, streaming November 20.
